items.title: Monoidal category
Mac Lane writes the associator in the opposite direction
The pentagon axiom and the triangle axiom are independent
items.strategy: Construct one monoidal-category witness satisfying the pentagon but not the triangle, and a second witness satisfying the triangle but not the pentagon. If only one witness closes at authoring time, narrow the statement to the verified half and record the other half as open.

items.title: Strict monoidal category
The reverse and the opposite of a monoidal category
A category with finite products is monoidal
items.strategy: Use binary products as tensor, the terminal object as unit, and the universal properties of products to define the associator and unitors. Verify the pentagon and triangle by uniqueness of arrows into the relevant product objects. State the cocartesian dual in the same item.

items.title: Set, Cat, and every complete category are cartesian monoidal
items.strategy: Apply the finite-product theorem to Set, to the category of small categories with product category as binary product, and to any complete category because completeness includes the terminal object and binary products.

items.title: The endomorphisms of the tensor unit form a commutative monoid
items.strategy: Transport the tensor and composition laws on endomorphisms of the unit through the unit constraints, check the interchange law, and invoke the published Eckmann-Hilton argument. Then read off the one-object strict-monoidal consequence as a comparison with an ordinary commutative monoid.

items.title: The endofunctor category of a small category is strict monoidal under composition
items.strategy: Use composition of endofunctors as the tensor product and the identity functor as the tensor unit. The smallness hypothesis is stated explicitly so the endofunctor category is legitimate under the library's functor-category convention.

items.title: A monoid object in a small endofunctor category is exactly a monad
items.strategy: Expand the monoid-object data in the strict monoidal category of endofunctors under composition, identify the multiplication and unit with the natural transformations of a monad, and match the associativity and unit diagrams to the monad laws. Keep the smallness hypothesis in the statement, not in a remark.

items.title: Monoid objects and comonoid objects in a monoidal category
Modules over a monoid object, their morphisms, and their category
Monoid objects in a cartesian monoidal category are ordinary monoids
items.strategy: Specialize the monoid-object diagrams to the cartesian tensor product, use the unique maps from and to the terminal object to identify the unit data, and unwind the universal properties until the data become an ordinary associative unital multiplication.

items.title: Abelian groups are monoidal under the tensor product
items.strategy: Read abelian groups as Z-modules, use the published tensor-product associativity and unit isomorphisms over a commutative ring, and specialize them to Z. Record explicitly that this branch is contingent on the already-published tensor-products page.

items.title: Monoid objects in abelian groups are rings
items.strategy: Transport the monoid-object multiplication and unit through the tensor-product description of bilinear maps over Z, then identify the additive structure with the ambient abelian-group law and the multiplicative structure with the monoid-object law.

items.title: Modules over a commutative ring form a monoidal category
items.strategy: Use the module tensor product over a commutative ring as tensor, the ring itself as tensor unit, and the published associativity, unit, and symmetry isomorphisms for module tensor products. Keep the ring-commutativity hypothesis in the statement so the outer actions are well typed.

items.title: A poset with finite meets is a strict monoidal category
items.strategy: Regard the poset as a category, use the meet as the tensor product and the top element as the tensor unit, and check associativity and unit as literal equalities of objects forced by the order-theoretic universal property of the meet.

items.title: The left unitor of a tensor product is determined by the associator
items.strategy: Use the triangle axiom with the right-unitor isomorphism at the second factor, then cancel the invertible map on the right to isolate the left-unitor formula. Keep the typed source and target of each composite explicit because the page cannot use unbracketed tensor strings.

items.title: The right unitor of a tensor product is determined by the associator
items.strategy: Apply the triangle axiom in the dual orientation and isolate the right-unitor formula by cancellation of invertible arrows. Keep the proof separate from the left-unitor case so later references can point to the exact displayed identity they need.

items.title: The two unitors agree on the tensor unit
items.strategy: Evaluate the left-unitor formula at the tensor unit, use the triangle axiom and the invertibility of the right tensor-by-unit functor, and identify the result with the right unitor at the unit.

items.title: How Mac Lane's original coherence conditions reduce to this page's two axioms
The unit-constraint redundancies are cited mathematically through EGNO
Lax, strong, and strict monoidal functors
Why the bare phrase 'monoidal functor' is ambiguous across sources
Monoidal natural transformation
Monoidal functors compose, and composition preserves laxness, strength, and strictness
items.strategy: Compose the underlying functors, compose the binary and unit structure maps in the only typed way, and check the associativity and unit diagrams by pasting the two given monoidal-functor diagrams. The strong and strict clauses are then immediate from the definitions.

items.title: A lax monoidal functor carries monoid objects to monoid objects
items.strategy: Push the multiplication and unit of a monoid object forward along the lax structure maps and verify the monoid-object diagrams by naturality together with the lax associativity and unit squares.

items.title: Monoidal equivalence and monoidal quasi-inverse data
Parenthesised tensor words and their evaluation functors
Parenthesised tensor words of a fixed length are counted by the Catalan numbers
items.strategy: Identify parenthesized tensor words on n letters with full binary trees on n leaves and count those trees. If the combinatorics page is used at authoring time, cite it explicitly there; otherwise prove the Catalan count locally by the standard binary-tree recurrence.

items.title: Unbracketed tensor strings are not yet defined on this page
Isbell's warning that isomorphic objects cannot simply be identified
FALSE: every monoidal category is strict
items.strategy: Use the Isbell-style skeleton example to show that strictification is only up to monoidal equivalence, not literal equality of associators and unit constraints.

items.title: FALSE: the unit constraints must be imposed as independent axioms
items.strategy: Refute the claim by the unit-redundancy theorems: the left and right unit formulas are forced by the associator and triangle, and the agreement on the tensor unit follows from them.

items.title: FALSE: a monoidal functor is exactly one whose structure maps are isomorphisms
items.strategy: Separate the lax, strong, and strict notions explicitly and use the convention remark to explain why the strong-only reading is source-specific rather than universal.

items.title: FALSE: the pentagon axiom follows from the triangle axiom
items.strategy: Invoke the independence theorem and point directly to the witness satisfying the triangle while failing the pentagon.

items.title: FALSE: an unbracketed three-fold tensor product is already well defined in any monoidal category
items.strategy: Refute the claim by the bracketing-discipline remark: before coherence, only the parenthesized tensor words are defined expressions, and the unbracketed form suppresses data the page has not yet proved irrelevant.

items.title: FALSE: a monoid object in an endofunctor category is the definition of a monad
items.strategy: Use the theorem equating the two notions only under the smallness hypothesis and cite the published remark explaining why the slogan is not a definition for arbitrary large categories.

title: Monoidal Categories and Monoidal Functors - Examples

items.title: The cartesian monoidal structure on sets computed
items.strategy: Write the tensor as cartesian product, the unit as a singleton, and spell out the associator and unitors on ordered pairs so the structure maps are concrete set bijections rather than abstract universal arrows.

items.title: The pentagon checked for cartesian products
items.strategy: Track a quadruple through the two routes around the pentagon for the cartesian product and verify that both routes yield the same rebracketing bijection.

items.title: A commutative monoid as a one-object strict monoidal category
items.strategy: Start from a commutative monoid, regard it as a one-object category, and read the multiplication as the tensor product on endomorphisms. Verify that the strict-monoidal law is literally the monoid law.

items.title: The five bracketings of a four-fold tensor product
items.strategy: List the five parenthesizations of a four-fold tensor word and indicate how the pentagon compares the two canonical routes between the left-associated and right-associated forms.

items.title: The free-monoid monad as a monoid object in the endofunctor category
items.strategy: Take the free-monoid monad on Set, view its unit and multiplication as endofunctor-category structure maps, and match them to the monoid-object theorem term by term.

items.title: The power-set functor is lax monoidal but not strong
items.strategy: Use cartesian monoidal structures on Set, define the structure map P(X) x P(Y) -> P(X x Y) by sending (A,B) to A x B, and show it is not an isomorphism when X and Y have at least two elements because not every subset of X x Y is a rectangle.

items.title: A skeleton of Set cannot be made strict by identifying isomorphic objects
items.strategy: Use the Isbell-style object D isomorphic to D x D with both projections epic and show that forcing the associator to be the identity collapses all endomorphisms D -> D.

items.title: Endofunctor composition as a strict tensor product
items.strategy: Choose a small category, spell out two endofunctors and their composite, and verify directly that associativity and the unit are literal equalities because composition of functors is strictly associative and unital.
